naive_sanity.daily_lag_definition: prediction at future step h uses the input load at origin+h-96; this matches the existing baseline implementation.
naive_sanity.weekly_lag_definition: prediction at future step h uses raw load at origin+h-672.
naive_sanity.blend_definition: alpha * raw load(origin+h-96) + (1-alpha) * raw load(origin+h-672), with alpha in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}.
